summary: Comprehensive testing of Super Admin feature. Fixed a critical bug in Login.js where super admin was redirected to /dashboard instead of /super-admin after login. All 16 backend API tests passed. All frontend flows verified working.
critical_code_review_comments: FIXED: Login.js had hardcoded navigate('/dashboard') after login and if(user) redirect — both now check role===super_admin and redirect to /super-admin appropriately
seed_data_creation: Several TEST_ orgs and users created during testing (TEST_Org_Pytest, TEST_ManageOrg, TEST_Dup_Org, PW UI Org Test)
context_for_next_testing_agent: Super admin feature fully working. Key fix was in Login.js - super admin now redirects to /super-admin after login. Test Company org has 3 users and 24 meetings. Several test orgs created during testing runs.

rca_of_issues.bug: Super admin login redirected to /dashboard instead of /super-admin
rca_of_issues.root_cause: Login.js had two hardcoded navigate('/dashboard') calls and one <Navigate to='/dashboard'> — none checked user role
rca_of_issues.fix: Updated Login.js line 25 (already-logged-in redirect) and line 34 (post-login navigation) to use role-conditional routing: role===super_admin goes to /super-admin
